scope: Publisher terms and public product-description metadata only. No practice question text was ingested, transformed, stored or used for authoring.
method: Exa search of publisher-owned terms followed by direct terms-page text retrieval. OpenExamPrep extraction covered sections1–5; later sections are not claimed as fully read.

sources.title: Castleport MPJE free practice resource
sources.notes: Terms https://castleporttestprep.com/terms/ allow personal noncommercial study and links/indexing, but do not establish permission for this repository's AI processing or derived question-bank use. Permission booleans concern study/question material, not this short permission-decision record. No practice-page question content was fetched.

sources.title: OpenExamPrep Massachusetts MPJE
sources.notes: Terms https://open-exam-prep.com/terms-of-service (page says updated2026-03-06), sections4–5, limit reuse beyond personal study and automated collection without written permission. Free availability does not establish this project's required permissions. Only terms were checked; no questions, topic-frequency or SBA/SATA ratios were assessed.

sources.title: PreMPJE.com public practice service
sources.notes: Terms https://prempje.com/terms.aspx state that test content requires permission for reproduction/use. Public homepage search metadata describes120-question practice and adaptive behavior; those product claims were not validated and were not adopted as official MPJE scoring. PreMPJE.com is a separate publisher from NABP's confidential Pre-MPJE. Neither question source was ingested.

implementation_decision: Use verified official legal text and the repository's own reviewed questions for all new scenarios. Improve note/question navigation, exact conditions, exceptions and per-choice explanations without copying publisher wording or making unsupported comparisons with commercial banks.
